description: Compare how enclosed the AcsD cellopentaose sites are against the glucan inside the BcsA translocation channel
code:
exec(open("_lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
def enclosure(pts, tree, rad, n_ray=256, reach=18.0, step=0.4):
    i=np.arange(n_ray)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*i/n_ray); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    D=np.column_stack([np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)])
    ts=np.arange(1.0,reach,step); ab=np.zeros(len(D),dtype=bool); pa=[]
    for k,d in enumerate(D):
        q=(pts[:,None,:]+d[None,None,:]*ts[None,:,None]).reshape(-1,3)
        dist,idx=tree.query(q,k=1,workers=-1)
        hit=(dist<rad[idx]).reshape(len(pts),len(ts)).any(1)
        ab[k]=hit.all(); pa.append(hit)
    return float(ab.mean()), float(np.array(pa).mean())

AA=set('ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL MSE'.split())
df=parse_pdb("./4HG6.pdb")
prot=df[df.resn.isin(AA)]
P=prot[["x","y","z"]].values; rad=prot.el.map(VDW).fillna(1.7).values; tree=cKDTree(P)
sug=df[(df.resn=="BGC")&(df.chain=="C")]
rows=[]
for s in range(1,15):
    w=sug[sug.resi.isin(range(s,s+5))]
    pts=w[["x","y","z"]].values
    a,b=enclosure(pts,tree,rad)
    d,i=tree.query(pts,k=12,workers=-1); cl=(d-rad[i]).min(1)
    rows.append(dict(system="BcsA/BcsB 4HG6", window=f"Glc{s}-{s+4}", enclosure_all=round(a,2),
                     enclosure_mean=round(b,2), min_gap=round(float(cl.min()),2)))
ctl=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("=== positive control: nascent glucan inside the BcsA transmembrane channel (4HG6) ===")
print(ctl.to_string(index=False))

# AcsD values recomputed with the same two metrics
B8=framed("3A8E"); prot8=B8[B8.resn!="BGC"]; sg=B8[B8.resn=="BGC"]
P8=prot8[["px","py","pz"]].values; rad8=prot8.el.map(VDW).fillna(1.7).values; t8=cKDTree(P8)
rows=[]
for uc,g in sg.groupby("uchain"):
    pts=g[["px","py","pz"]].values; a,b=enclosure(pts,t8,rad8)
    d,i=t8.query(pts,k=12,workers=-1); cl=(d-rad8[i]).min(1)
    rows.append(dict(system="AcsD 3A8E", window=uc, enclosure_all=round(a,2),
                     enclosure_mean=round(b,2), min_gap=round(float(cl.min()),2)))
acs=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== AcsD octamer cellopentaose sites, same metric ===")
print(acs.to_string(index=False))
both=pd.concat([ctl,acs]); both.to_csv("enclosure_comparison.csv",index=False)
print("\nBcsA channel max enclosure_mean = %.2f ; AcsD mean = %.2f"%(ctl.enclosure_mean.max(), acs.enclosure_mean.mean()))

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4))
ax.plot(range(1,15), ctl.enclosure_mean, "o-", color="#2b6cb0", label="BcsA/BcsB glucan, 5-unit windows (4HG6)")
ax.axhspan(acs.enclosure_mean.min(), acs.enclosure_mean.max(), color="#dd6b20", alpha=.25)
ax.axhline(acs.enclosure_mean.mean(), color="#dd6b20", lw=2, label="AcsD cellopentaose sites (3A8E)")
ax.set_xlabel("first glucose of 5-unit window along the BcsA glucan")
ax.set_ylabel("fraction of directions blocked by protein\n(within 18 A)")
ax.set_title("Glucan burial: AcsD lumen groove vs the BcsA translocation channel")
ax.set_ylim(0,1); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
